summary: activityLog.hiddenTools lists tools (model-facing names) that never appear in the activity log, e.g. UI-only refresh or toast actions; they still run.
howTo: activityLog={{ hiddenTools: ['ui_action_toast', 'ui_action_refresh'] }} (config.activityLog on <glirastes-chat>). Hidden tools are no step, no summary count, no section split and do not hide the typing indicator. A hand-built ChatContextValue (a test mock of useChatContext) sets activityLog.hiddenTools: [].
